specializations.name: Media Ingest and Normalization
specializations.inputs: Footage/audio/image metadata, timecode, orientation, variable frame rate and source color tags
specializations.decision: Preserve immutable originals and create explicit proxies with source-to-timeline maps; normalize only what the selected pipeline requires.
specializations.mechanism: Explicit mappings and ownership make downstream edits attributable and reproducible.
specializations.tradeoff: Unrecorded frame-rate conversion or rotation breaks every downstream coordinate and cue.
specializations.verification: Compare known source frames and audio anchors against normalized media; test orientation, duration and seek behavior.
specializations.output: Asset manifest, proxy mapping and decode capability report
specializations.evidence: Authored operational contract; validate with actual project artifacts.
specializations.failure: Unrecorded frame-rate conversion or rotation breaks every downstream coordinate and cue.
specializations.recovery: Rebuild the proxy and its mapping, then invalidate dependent track/caption/edit evidence.

specializations.name: Transcript and Speech Alignment
specializations.inputs: Final decoded speech, approved transcript, speaker IDs and alignment provenance
specializations.decision: Distinguish authored phrase cues from measured word/phoneme alignment; correct transcript before emphasis and captions.
specializations.mechanism: Explicit mappings and ownership make downstream edits attributable and reproducible.
specializations.tradeoff: Estimated timestamps can appear plausible while drifting from spoken audio.
specializations.verification: Listen across phrase boundaries and compare actual audio with the claimed word/phoneme evidence.
specializations.output: Reviewed cue map with timing precision and uncertainty
specializations.evidence: Authored operational contract; validate with actual project artifacts.
specializations.failure: Estimated timestamps can appear plausible while drifting from spoken audio.
specializations.recovery: Re-align changed audio ranges; propagate offsets to captions, editorial cuts and lip sync.

specializations.name: Temporal Layout and Collision
specializations.inputs: Projected protected bounds, time intervals, placement masks and object priority
specializations.decision: Evaluate collisions over relevant motion intervals; preserve critical text/face bounds and allow intentional decorative overflow.
specializations.mechanism: Explicit mappings and ownership make downstream edits attributable and reproducible.
specializations.tradeoff: Static safe-frame checks miss transient overlaps and time-dependent interface occlusion.
specializations.verification: Inspect holds plus maximum expansion/camera extremes and the first contact between bounds.
specializations.output: Timed layout findings and chosen priority resolutions
specializations.evidence: Authored operational contract; validate with actual project artifacts.
specializations.failure: Static safe-frame checks miss transient overlaps and time-dependent interface occlusion.
specializations.recovery: Reflow, restage or cut away; invalidate only affected layout variants and their rendered ranges.

specializations.name: Tracking Confidence and Recovery
specializations.inputs: Anchor trajectories, coordinate transforms, confidence, masks and occlusion intervals
specializations.decision: Keep tracked coordinates in the source frame with explicit transforms to output space; mark loss of confidence and use reviewed manual anchors or gaps.
specializations.mechanism: Explicit mappings and ownership make downstream edits attributable and reproducible.
specializations.tradeoff: A convincing first frame can hide identity switches after occlusion.
specializations.verification: Inspect entry, exit, re-entry and maximal perspective change against the actual filmed subject.
specializations.output: Confidence-aware tracks, manual corrections and gap policy
specializations.evidence: Authored operational contract; validate with actual project artifacts.
specializations.failure: A convincing first frame can hide identity switches after occlusion.
specializations.recovery: Stop extrapolating through uncertain ranges and change to a cut/crop if the effect cannot be stabilized.

specializations.name: Editorial Retiming and Dependency Repair
specializations.inputs: Old/new shot ranges, cue precision, source maps and performance tracks
specializations.decision: Represent time edits as explicit piecewise mappings; handle cut, stretch, hold and reverse semantics separately.
specializations.mechanism: Explicit mappings and ownership make downstream edits attributable and reproducible.
specializations.tradeoff: Stretching the picture alone invalidates speech, captions, contact and cached simulation.
specializations.verification: Compare boundary-neighbor frames and speech/contact anchors before and after the edit.
specializations.evidence: Authored operational contract; validate with actual project artifacts.
specializations.failure: Stretching the picture alone invalidates speech, captions, contact and cached simulation.
specializations.recovery: Rebuild dependent cues or re-perform narration; preserve intelligibility rather than forcing arbitrary speed.

specializations.name: Dialogue Restoration and Stem Balance
specializations.inputs: Speech/noise stems, sample rate, speech priority and mix context
specializations.decision: Apply the minimum cleanup needed; maintain intelligible consonants and compare processed/bypass speech in the real mix.
specializations.mechanism: Explicit mappings and ownership make downstream edits attributable and reproducible.
specializations.tradeoff: Aggressive denoising, gating or limiting can damage intelligibility and naturalness.
specializations.verification: Listen through quiet words, breath/phrase joins and loud events; inspect clipping and start/end alignment.
specializations.output: Reviewed dialogue stem, gain automation and processing settings
specializations.evidence: Authored operational contract; validate with actual project artifacts.
specializations.failure: Aggressive denoising, gating or limiting can damage intelligibility and naturalness.
specializations.recovery: Back off the damaging process and revise competing music/SFX before intensifying cleanup.

specializations.name: Reusable Component Contracts
specializations.inputs: Component identity/version, editable parameters, bounds, cue channels and dependency IDs
specializations.decision: Expose stable render/time/bounds interfaces and declare allowed overrides; share one master rather than copying divergent shot implementations.
specializations.mechanism: Explicit mappings and ownership make downstream edits attributable and reproducible.
specializations.tradeoff: An unversioned component edit can silently change many scenes or character identities.
specializations.verification: Render default and extreme parameter cases and verify bounds, time evaluation and dependency identity.
specializations.output: Versioned component schema and migration/invalidation rules
specializations.evidence: Authored operational contract; validate with actual project artifacts.
specializations.failure: An unversioned component edit can silently change many scenes or character identities.
specializations.recovery: Pin unaffected shots or migrate overrides explicitly; regenerate impacted frames and reviews.

specializations.name: Variant Rendering and Export Lineage
specializations.inputs: Master edit, placement requirements, caption language, aspect ratio and build signatures
specializations.decision: Derive placement/language variants from one semantic edit while keeping per-variant layout and reviewed export lineage.
specializations.mechanism: Explicit mappings and ownership make downstream edits attributable and reproducible.
specializations.tradeoff: Blind scaling or stale caches can silently mix media from different revisions.
specializations.verification: Check each variant signature, protected bounds, actual streams and source-to-output relationships.
specializations.output: Variant manifest and verified export set
specializations.evidence: Authored operational contract; validate with actual project artifacts.
specializations.failure: Blind scaling or stale caches can silently mix media from different revisions.
specializations.recovery: Regenerate mismatched variants and report unverified ones separately.
